criteria.text: Type 2 diabetes mellitus; adjunct to diet and exercise (Indications and Usage; approval criterion 1).
Diagnosis is supported by documentation from the patient medical record (approval criterion 1).
Trial and failure or inadequate response to metformin or other antidiabetic medication (approval criterion 2).
Patient is at least 18 years old (approval criterion 3).

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Invokana (canagliflozin), an SGLT2 inhibitor available as 100mg and 300mg tablets. PDF Version 1, last updated 10/14/2013, Approved 11/15/2013. source.effective_date uses the PDF approval date instead of the 1970-01-01 placeholder; no separate effective date is stated.

Approval requires documented type 2 diabetes mellitus, trial and failure or inadequate response to metformin or other antidiabetic medication, and age at least 18. Diagnosis documentation and therapy history are attestations.
Limitation of Use: not for treatment of type 1 diabetes mellitus or diabetic ketoacidosis; non-T2DM indications fail the indication predicate.
Authorization (notes only): coverage may be approved for 12 months.
Dispensing and quantity limits (notes only): 30-day supply; 100mg up to 1 tablet per day; 300mg up to 1 tablet per day.
Remains partial: medical record and therapy evidence verification, authorization duration, days supply and quantity enforcement require manual review. max_units is null. PDL status unknown.
